purpose: Normalize map-name OpenText candidates before any routing decision.

洛阳司.reason: The gold frame immediately right of 阳 was observed as a false third glyph on the 2026-07-15 live frame.

rules: Normalize Unicode and keep only CJK ideographs, ASCII letters and digits.
Prefer an accepted sample_match result when its score is at least 0.70.
Accept OpenText only for an exact known name or an explicitly reviewed alias.
Do not use prefix containment to collapse a longer valid map such as 楼兰藏宝洞 into 楼兰.
Do not invent generic one-character correction. Unreviewed near matches remain unknown.
Expose a stable canonical name only after at least 2 matching votes in the last 3 independent frames.
Unknown or unstable output must not reach a routing state machine as a confirmed map.
